annotations.title: Why that duty rate applies, with the tariff heading

description: Explain WHY a given category pays what it pays on a given route: the tariff heading, the rule behind the rate, and worked examples below and above the threshold that changes it. Use this when someone asks not just how much, but on what basis — or when you need to cite a source rather than assert a rate.
